elements.element: No non-solicitation obligation binding Customer at all
elements.evidence: "neither party shall solicit ... any person who was an employee of the other party" — a covenant still binds Customer
"neither party shall solicit or allow its respective affiliates to solicit"; "This restriction is mutual and binds each party equally"

elements.element: Scope limited to personnel directly involved in the services
elements.evidence: "who was directly involved in the provision of services under this Agreement"

elements.element: Duration 12 months measured from the end of the person's involvement
elements.evidence: "For a period of 12 months after the end of any person's involvement" (term-of-Agreement limb deleted)
"or to unsolicited approaches by any such person"
"not to hire or allow its respective affiliates to hire" replaced with "shall not solicit ... to solicit"

offending_extra_words: This restriction is mutual and binds each party equally,
reasons: Fallback is fully satisfied: solicitation-only (no-hire deleted), mutual, limited to personnel directly involved in the services, 12 months from the end of involvement, with general-advertisement and unsolicited-approach carve-outs.
Preferred position (no non-solicit on Customer) is not achieved; a mutual covenant still binds us, which is acceptable at the locked fallback level.

Minor minimality slip: mutuality is already carried by "neither party shall solicit", so "This restriction is mutual and binds each party equally" is duplicative boilerplate; the inserted sentence should have carried only the two carve-outs.
No undefined terms, contradictions or dangling mechanics introduced; the six-month look-back limb is subsumed by the involvement-based trigger, which is neutral-to-favourable to us.
